title: 煅玉堂 第八十七章 设计离去煅玉堂 第八十六章 修为增进
content_zh:
秦凤鸣深思过，与汤巍真仙同行，肯定能威慑阚芜仙域不少宗门，但也不会太平，如果有孤注一掷的宗门全力出手，只凭太清宫名头，真就不会有太大威慑力。
只要魔阴宫答应那个宗门举宗迁到魔阴宫核心之地，并许以逆天好处，成为魔阴宫核心外门势力，想来有不少宗门愿意做。
如真有十几位真仙图谋围堵，只汤巍真仙一人，他真就会陷入极其危险境地。
哪怕是金波神君可以显露出些许威能，说不定也会被窦德真仙身上携带的手段克制。真到那时，他就只能束手待擒了。
秦凤鸣神情郑重点头：“他们要擒拿的是晚辈，只要没有堵截住秦某，就算再多修士拦截前辈，前辈也应该会平安。”
汤巍真仙目光闪动，知道秦凤鸣所言不错。
“你之所以要大张旗鼓炼制丹药，原来打的就是这番主意，如此安排倒也不错。老夫会联系韦杞师弟去到烈阳门，只要韦师弟到了，就算有再多真仙围堵也是不惧。”
汤巍真仙点头，同意了秦凤鸣提议。
很快，两人就相商好了方案。拍卖会，秦凤鸣必需要现身的，要离去，也只有中途时离场。
到此时，汤巍真仙是真的喜欢面前这位青年修士。
丹道高深修士，太清宫有不少，但如此有朝气的丹道大师不常见。就是圣师，都没人愿意炼制玄牝锁阳丹，但面前青年不仅做了，而且能接连炼制。这让见多识广的汤巍真仙也大是不解。
拍卖会如期举行，偌大的拍卖广场人山人海，聚集了足有数万修士。当然其中九成九是看热闹之人，只有真仙大能才是拍卖的主力。
秦凤鸣首先登台，一番开场白后，汤巍真仙开始主持这次的玄牝锁阳丹拍卖。
第一枚玄牝锁阳丹最后成交价竟达到了七万六千仙灵石。这让秦凤鸣不由脑海砰跳。他满以为能拍到五万仙灵石就已经算是天价，竟一举突破了七万之数。
一枚枚玄牝锁阳丹拍卖出，价格都在六七万仙灵石。这让在场群修兴奋，如此高价的拍卖，哪怕不参与其中，也足可成为人们的谈资。
更高级的拍卖会，肯定能拍出更高价格，但在真仙等阶，丹药能拍出五万仙灵石已经算是天价。寻常真仙丹药拍卖价格也就两三万仙灵石，玄牝锁阳丹竟翻了两三番。
五枚丹药拍完，秦凤鸣再次出现在拍卖台。
“多谢各位前辈慷慨，下面五枚玄牝锁阳丹拍卖，秦某准许用灵草材料抵用仙灵石。如果哪位前辈能拿出一捧玄荒土，晚辈愿意与前辈兑换两枚玄牝锁阳丹。好了，半个时辰后拍卖继续。”
秦凤鸣开口，声音传遍了整个广场。顿时间，广场之上立即喧哗之声大起。
玄荒土，那是培养先天灵物的逆天之物，在弥罗界中，绝对算是最顶尖的那波逆天神物。

秦凤鸣话语说完，立即离开了拍卖台。
广场群修不会离去，众人议论，有意之人更是盘算下面如何配比自己出价。
“前辈，晚辈去了，董迁与丁原交由前辈照看。”秦凤鸣辞别汤巍真仙，安排董迁与丁原，然后改变容颜，跟着一位连云城城主去了。
他没有走城门，而是被那位城主引到了一处僻静处，用禁制盘在护城大阵上启了一道缝隙，出去了。
content_en:
Qin Fengming thought deeply that walking with True Immortal Tang Wei would definitely intimidate many sects in the Kanwu Immortal Domain, but it would not lead to peace. If a desperate sect took full action, the name of Taiqing Palace alone would not have much deterrence.
As long as Moyin Palace agrees to move that sect to the core of Moyin Palace and promises unnatural benefits to become the core outer sect force of Moyin Palace, I think many sects are willing to do it.
If there were more than a dozen True Immortals trying to block him, and only True Immortal Tang Wei was the only one, he would really be in an extremely dangerous situation.
Even if Jinbo Shenjun can show some power, he may be restrained by the means carried by True Immortal Dou De. At that point, he would have no choice but to wait and be captured.
Qin Fengming nodded solemnly: "What they want to capture is the junior. As long as Qin is not intercepted, even if more monks intercept the senior, the senior should be safe."
Immortal Tang Wei's eyes flashed, knowing that what Qin Fengming said was true.
"The reason why you want to refine the elixir in a big way is because of this idea. This arrangement is not bad. I will contact Junior Brother Wei Qi to go to Lieyang Gate. As long as Junior Brother Wei arrives, he will not be afraid no matter how many true immortals block him."
Immortal Tang Wei nodded and agreed to Qin Fengming's proposal.
Soon, the two of them discussed a plan. Qin Fengming must show up at the auction. If he wants to leave, he can only leave in the middle of the auction.
By this time, Immortal Tang Wei really liked the young monk in front of him.
There are many advanced alchemy monks in Taiqing Palace, but such energetic alchemy masters are not common. Even the holy masters, no one was willing to refine the Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill, but the young man in front of him not only did it, but was able to refine it continuously. This puzzled the well-informed Immortal Tang Wei.
The auction was held as scheduled, and the huge auction square was crowded with tens of thousands of monks. Of course, 99% of them are people watching the excitement, and only the true immortals are the main force in the auction.
Qin Fengming was the first to take the stage. After some opening remarks, Immortal Tang Wei began to preside over the auction of Xuanfei Cynomorium Pill.
The final transaction price of the first Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill reached 76,000 immortal spirit stones. This made Qin Fengming's mind pounding. He thought that being able to get 50,000 immortal spirit stones would be considered a sky-high price, but he actually exceeded 70,000 in one fell swoop.
Each Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill was auctioned, and the price was sixty or seventy thousand immortal spirit stones. This made the cultivators present excited. Such a high-priced auction, even if they did not participate in it, was enough to become a topic of conversation.
Higher-level auctions will definitely fetch higher prices, but at the True Immortal level, a pill that can fetch 50,000 Immortal Spirit Stones is already considered a sky-high price. Normally, the auction price of the True Immortal Pill is only 20,000 to 30,000 Immortal Spirit Stones, but the price of Xuan Ni Cynomorium Pill has been doubled or tripled.
After the five elixirs were auctioned, Qin Fengming appeared on the auction stage again.
"Thank you for your generosity, seniors. The following five Xuanfei Cynomorium Pills are being auctioned. Qin agreed to use spiritual grass materials to exchange for fairy spirit stones. If any senior can come up with a handful of Xuanhuang soil, I am willing to exchange them with my seniors for two Xuanfei Cynomorium Pills. Okay, the auction will continue in half an hour."
Qin Fengming spoke, and his voice spread throughout the square. Suddenly, there was a loud noise in the square.
Xuanhuang soil is a heaven-defying thing that cultivates innate spiritual beings. In the Miluo world, it is definitely the top wave of heaven-defying divine things.
After Qin Fengming finished speaking, he immediately left the auction stage.
The cultivators in the square will not leave. Everyone is talking about it, and those who are interested are even thinking about how to match their bids.
"Senior, junior has gone. Dong Qian and Ding Yuan are in the care of senior." Qin Fengming said goodbye to Immortal Tang Wei, arranged for Dong Qian and Ding Yuan, then changed his appearance and followed a Lianyun City lord.
He did not go through the city gate, but was led to a secluded place by the city lord. He used the restriction disk to open a gap in the city defense formation and went out.
